title: Aggregate-only outcome, timing and safety crosswalk for NCT05371041
key_finding: Baseline 0–100 versus endpoint 0–50 definitions and postoperative versus DBS-initiation clocks do not establish a compatible aggregate clinical estimator. Protocol p6 additionally distinguishes IPG implantation from lead surgery.

safety.window: Enrollment through follow-up, approximately two years after lead implantation.

claim_supported: Specific public-document compatibility gaps and interpretable aggregate safety metadata.
uncertainty: Operational clock, common outcome construct, aggregate paired estimator and exposure/missingness accounting unresolved.
related_cohort_ids: PMID40977255: smaller physiology report in same trial family, not independent replication
data_access: No participant rows retained, reconstructed or analyzed; no outreach or data request.
review_scope: Exact named protocol/SAP/posted-result metadata, no systematic review.
next_verification_task: Close fixed crosswalk pending public clarification; advance distinct NCT02056873 clinical/function estimand audit.
